data.long_meaning: Wafiza is an Arabic name for girls that means open, clear, pure. It is derived from the Arabic word 'wafa', which means sincerity, loyalty, and faithfulness. The name evokes images of a gentle, radiant, and honest soul, one who is open to new experiences and clear in her intentions.

This concept is central to Islamic beliefs, which encourage individuals to be loyal and true to their faith, their loved ones, and their principles. The name serves as a reminder to its bearer to remain steadfast in her beliefs and to lead a pure and honest life in accordance with the teachings of Islam. Thus, the name Wafiza embodies the values of sincerity, loyalty, and honesty, both culturally and spiritually.
